notes.title: Reduced Price & Tons of new features!!
notes.content:
Same Fun! Reduced Price!
After debating for a while, I've decided to drastically reduce the price of Angles of Death from $3.99 to $.99!!

I did this for a couple reasons, but mostly because I'd love to see more people play my game. When Angles of Death was first launched, I had this crazy (to me) idea that I'd maybe sell 10 or so copies of my game. Well, I've far surpassed that, and would like to show my appreciation by reducing the price drastically so more people can hopefully discover and play this passion project of mine.

Five year old me who dreamed of making video games after playing games on the NES would be proud.

I hope you guys enjoy my game!! Good luck destroying the Angles!

1. Enemies show a damage indicator to make hitting Angles that much more satisfying!

2. A re-roll function has been added to the game to help with choosing upgrades!

3. A high score leaderboard has been implemented into the game. How many waves can you crush?

4. Right click - Now you can move with a right click mouse button! Hold it down to have your player chase your cursor!

5. Upgraded tooltips - See what each upgrade does and see the max level of each upgrade.

6. New upgrades and skills are always being thought of! Do you have an idea for an awesome new upgrade or attack? Let me know!
